*Stub — agree on these in lab meeting and record the decisions here.*

## Projects

Suggested pattern: `YYYY_short-project-name`.

## Files

- Lowercase, hyphens or underscores, no spaces.
- Dates as `YYYY-MM-DD` so files sort chronologically.
- Never encode the only copy of metadata in a filename — keep a README or sample sheet alongside.

## Samples

Define the sample ID scheme per project before collecting data.
